tenders.title: SELECTION OF Architects / Architectural Firms for providing architectural designs and services towards Development of Research Park and associated facilities at IIT Bhilai
tenders.scope_summary: IIT Bhilai invites proposals from architects/architectural firms for providing design services for their Research Park and associated facilities. The scope includes BIM modeling, sustainability assessment, quantity surveying, and cost estimation, with a focus on advanced design and coordination platforms.
key_points: Demonstrable experience in using BIM platforms (Autodesk Revit, ArchiCAD or equivalent) is required; all drawings must be prepared in BIM/Revit.
Proficiency in CAD, 3D visualization, and documentation tools.
Service integration (internal and external) to be prepared and submitted in BIM/Revit model with clash detection features.
Minimum average annual turnover of Rs. 3.0 Crores in the last three financial years (2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25).
Submission of technical bid (without financial bid) as hard copies.
Evaluation based on Quality-cum-Cost Based Selection (QCBS) methodology.
Tender fee Rs 1000/- and EMD Rs 3,00,000/-.

tenders.title: INTERIOR DECORATION AND AESTHETIC UPLIFTMENT OF LOBBY AREA OF OFFICE OF R&D, IIT Kharagpur
tenders.scope_summary: IIT Kharagpur invites bids for interior decoration and aesthetic upliftment of the Lobby Area of the Office of R&D. The scope includes space planning, 2D layout, 3D design, and virtual walkthroughs.
key_points: Space Planning & 2D layout and 3D design along with virtual walkthrough.
Provide and install a suspended wooden ceiling system.
Coordination with MEP services and precise cut-outs for lighting and fixtures.
Average Annual Turnover of at least 30,00,000 INR during last 3 financial years (2023-24, 2024-25, and 2025-26).
Past experience of an integrated project of similar nature with an order value of Rs. 30 lakhs and above.
Warranty of 5 years after successful installation and demonstration.

tenders.title: Supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning of IoT-based Ultrasonic-type Digital water meters Confirming to ISO:4064-2014 for water supply lines to the additional Buildings at IIT Hyderabad, Kandi, Sangareddy.
tenders.scope_summary: IIT Hyderabad invites bids for the supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of IoT-based ultrasonic digital water meters for new buildings. The system should support data logging, transmission, and internal storage for a minimum of one year.
key_points: IoT-based Ultrasonic-type Digital water meters confirming to ISO:4064-2014.
Data logging & transmission frequency: Every 24 hours / 8 hours by default, configurable over the air.
Data storage internally in the meter for minimum 1 year.
Lithium battery with a minimum life of 5 years with 1 transmission per day, replaceable on field.
Bid will be treated as abnormally low if the quoted bid amount is lesser than 80% of the estimated cost.
Predictive maintenance of devices.
